title: Multihead Lightweight Attention UNet for Medical Image Classification and Segmentation
description: Ongoing research on a lightweight multihead attention-based U-Net architecture for medical image classification and segmentation, aimed at improving accuracy while reducing computational overhead for deployment in resource-constrained clinical settings.

title: Deepfake Video Detection Using Deep Learning
description: A multi-year research line on detecting AI-generated and manipulated video content. Spans a systematic survey of deepfake creation/detection methods, a CNN-based approach for short and low-resolution deepfake clips, and a hybrid deep learning architecture for identifying fake visual evidence in judicial/legal settings. Originated from undergraduate thesis work on deepfake detection using CNN and RCNN.

title: Water Quality Prediction and Monitoring Using AI
description: Research on AI-driven surface water quality assessment, combining a large-scale historical dataset (1940–2023) with ensemble machine learning and attention-based LSTM models to forecast the Water Quality Index (WQI) while minimizing eclipsing and ambiguity issues in classical WQI methods.

title: Medical Image Analysis with Explainable AI
description: A body of work applying deep learning and explainable AI (X-AI) to medical imaging tasks, including brain tumor segmentation (EfficientNet + U-Net), X-AI-driven brain cancer detection and localization, vision transformer-based breast cancer categorization from histopathology images, and a broader review of computer vision algorithms in healthcare.
